levels.label: Remember
levels.description: Retrieve relevant knowledge from memory by recognizing or recalling.

levels.label: Understand
levels.description: Construct meaning by interpreting, classifying, summarizing, comparing, or explaining.

levels.label: Apply
levels.description: Carry out or use a procedure in a given situation.

levels.label: Analyze
levels.description: Separate material into parts and identify their relationships and overall structure.

levels.label: Evaluate
levels.description: Make judgments using criteria and standards through checking or critique.

levels.label: Create
levels.description: Combine elements into a coherent new whole through generating, planning, or producing.

levels.label: Factual
levels.description: Knowledge of basic elements, terminology, and specific details.

levels.label: Conceptual
levels.description: Knowledge of categories, principles, theories, models, and how they relate.

levels.label: Procedural
levels.description: Knowledge of subject-specific skills, algorithms, techniques, methods, and when to use them.

levels.label: Metacognitive
levels.description: Knowledge of learning strategies, thinking tasks, and one's own strengths and limitations.
